annotations.title: Record a slip from what you read on it

description: Hand in a receipt, till slip, fuel slip or supplier invoice that the user showed you (photo or PDF in the chat): read it yourself and send the details printed on it. It is filed under Slips & Documents for the business to check and post — nothing is posted to the ledger. The reply contains a one-time upload link: give it to the user so they can attach the original slip (needed for a VAT claim). Only send what is printed; leave out anything you cannot read. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

account_code.description: Expense account code from accounting_chart_of_accounts, only if the user chose one

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

note.description: What it was for, in the user's words (e.g. "client lunch", "office printer ink")

payment_method.description: card, cash, eft or account, if printed

supplier_vat_number.description: Supplier VAT number if printed (10 digits starting with 4)

total.description: Total amount paid or owed, VAT included, in rand

vat_amount.description: VAT amount printed on the slip (omit if none is printed)

name: accounting_record_slip
